Name: Wallet Tools - Tool Upgrade Bundles Addon
Author: ThaleTheGreat
Description:
[b][size=4]Wallet Tools for Tool Upgrade Bundles[/size][/b] makes [b]Wallet Tools[/b] and [b]Tool Upgrade Bundles[/b] work together.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42725]Tool Upgrade Bundles[/url] replaces Clint’s normal tool upgrade path with an anvil and bundle-based upgrade system. 

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47136]Wallet Tools[/url] stores your tools in the wallet instead of keeping them in your inventory. Without this patch, the anvil may not see wallet-stored tools when checking which upgrades are available.

This addon makes [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42725]Tool Upgrade Bundles[/url] recognize tools stored by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47136]Wallet Tools[/url].

[b]All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/b]
